violations.title: A VAT breakdown (BG-23) with a Reverse charge (AE) VAT category code (BT-118) SHALL have a VAT exemption reason code (BT-121) meaning 'Reverse charge' or the reason text (BT-120) 'Reverse charge' — the presence-required shape shared with BR-E-10.
violations.fix_hint: Add the required element at `/ubl:Invoice/cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal/cac:TaxCategory[normalize-space(cbc:ID) = 'AE'][cac:TaxScheme/normalize-space(upper-case(cbc:ID))='VAT']`: A VAT breakdown (BG-23) with VAT Category code (BT-118) "Reverse charge" shall have a VAT exemption reason code (BT-121), meaning "Reverse charge" or the VAT exemption reason text (BT-120) "Reverse charge" (or the equivalent standard text in another language).
